spans.s: अये ind. 1. A vocative particle, अये गौरीनाथ त्रिपुरहर शम्भो त्रिनयन Bhartr.iii.; 2. an interjection- (1) of anger; (2) of fatigue; (3) of recollection; (4) of fear; (5) of surprise; (6) of grief, अये देवपादपद्मोपजीविनोवस्थेयम् Mud.ii.
आये ind. An interjection of calling, expressive of affection.
